scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the statutory cure period, the payment demand and threat of termination, and when the warning was served.
These documents are needed to assess whether the arrears termination used the required form and was validly and timely delivered.
These records are needed together to establish the payment’s bank value date and the property manager’s posting date relative to expiry of the cure period and termination.
These documents are needed to verify the written arrears cure notice, its threatened termination, and the date on which the cure period was validly served and expired.
These records are needed to establish the payment instruction and value dates and to clarify the manager's asserted posting date.
These documents are needed to assess whether the termination used the required official form and was served on time after any unmet cure period.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the content, statutory deadlines, prescribed termination form, and legally relevant service dates of the arrears warning and termination.
These documents are needed to establish the payment instruction and value dates, the landlord's actual crediting or posting date, and the basis of the disputed timing.
These documents are needed to verify the written arrears warning, the payment deadline, and when the warning was validly served.
These documents are needed to establish the bank value date, the landlord's posting date, and whether the arrears were paid before expiry of the cure period.
These documents are needed to assess whether the termination used the required official form and was served on a valid date after an uncured arrears period.

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the date and separate lawful service of the payment deadline warning.
These records are needed to verify whether the claimed rent or ancillary-cost arrears existed and whether they were paid within the deadline.
These documents are needed to verify whether the rent or ancillary-cost arrears asserted in the 28 April 2026 payment demand were actually outstanding.
These documents are needed to establish when and how the payment-demand warning was served and therefore when any payment deadline began.

These records are needed to establish the payment’s bank value date, the landlord’s actual receipt and posting date, and the parties’ contemporaneous positions on the disputed timing.

These records are needed to establish the payment’s value date and whether it was made within the payment deadline rather than merely booked internally later.
The parties’ communications and any stated termination reasons may clarify the alleged payment timing, the management’s booking position, and the basis for the termination.
These documents are needed to establish the warning’s deadline, the bank value date and payment timing, and the management’s asserted internal booking date.
These documents are needed to verify the termination’s prescribed form, its effective termination date, and the date and manner of service.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the statutory cure-period and termination contents and the dates and manner in which the warning and termination were served.
These records are needed together to establish the payment instruction, bank value date, crediting date, and the property manager’s asserted posting date.
Correspondence from the landlord or manager is needed to document the stated basis for claiming that payment was posted only after termination.
These documents are needed to verify the termination’s required form and the date and manner of service, including whether any collection notice affected receipt.

These documents are needed to establish the cure deadline, the payment’s bank value date, and the management’s asserted posting date before determining whether arrears still existed when termination was issued.

Sie klären den Valuta- und Ausführungszeitpunkt der Mietzahlung sowie die von der Verwaltung behauptete interne Verbuchung.
Die schriftliche Kündigungsbegründung wird benötigt, falls die Verwaltung die Kündigung nicht ausschliesslich auf den behaupteten Zahlungsverzug stützt.

These records are needed to establish the bank value date, the property manager’s posting date, and whether payment was made within the cure period before termination.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the warning’s contents, the 30-day cure period, and when the warning was validly delivered.
These records are needed to establish the payment instruction, value date, crediting/posting date, and the management’s stated position on timing.
The official termination form is needed to assess whether the arrears termination complied with the mandatory form, stated termination date, and required information.
These are needed to verify the cure notice’s statutory content, its 30-day deadline, and when it was validly served.
These are needed to establish the payment’s bank value date and whether payment occurred before the cure deadline rather than merely when management posted it.
These are needed to assess whether the subsequent arrears termination used the required official form and was served on the relevant date.
Management correspondence may document its asserted posting date and its position on the timing of payment and termination.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the content, statutory deadlines, form, and effective delivery dates of the arrears warning and termination.
These records are needed together to establish when the payment was instructed, value-dated, and credited in relation to the cure period and termination.
These documents are needed to confirm the manager’s asserted posting date and the stated factual basis for the termination.
These documents are needed to verify the statutory cure demand, threatened and issued termination, and the respective deadlines.
These records are needed to establish the payment instruction, value date, and the property manager’s booking date against the cure period and termination date.

These complementary records are needed to determine when payment was made and whether it occurred within the cure period despite the disputed posting date.
These are needed to assess the termination’s prescribed form, termination date, and service timing.
Correspondence from the manager may document the asserted posting date and the stated basis for treating the payment as late.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the termination’s prescribed form, separate delivery, and the date of receipt for calculating any challenge deadline.
These documents are needed to establish the amount and date of the tenant’s rent payment during the cure period.
The landlord’s correspondence is needed to obtain the rent ledger, fridge-invoice details, and any stated allocation of the payment between rent and the damage claim.
A written statement of the landlord’s reasons is needed to clarify whether the termination was based solely on qualifying rent or ancillary-cost arrears.
These are needed to verify the termination’s prescribed form, actual receipt date, and any service defects.
These are needed to reconstruct the claimed rent arrears, the fridge-invoice component, and allocation of the tenant’s payment.
The landlord’s stated reason is needed to assess whether the arrears termination rests on a valid outstanding rent debt.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify whether a termination was issued on the prescribed form and validly delivered, including the relevant receipt date.
These documents are needed to determine which alleged arrears and refrigerator-damage amounts the landlord relied on for the termination.
These documents are needed to reconstruct the rent payment, its payment reference or allocation instruction, and the remaining pure rent balance separately from the damage invoice.
These are needed to assess the content, effective date, prescribed form, and service of the alleged arrears-based termination.
These are needed to separate rent from the refrigerator claim, trace Luca Huber’s payment, and establish how the landlord allocated it and what rent arrears, if any, remained.
This is needed to confirm the landlord’s asserted termination ground and whether it relies on unpaid rent, the damage invoice, or both.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Diese Unterlagen werden benötigt, um Form, Zugangsdatum und die konkret angegebene Begründung der wegen Konkurs ausgesprochenen Kündigung zu prüfen.
Die vor der Kündigung geführte Korrespondenz kann klären, ob die Vermieterin vor der Konkurskündigung noch Anforderungen oder Fristen gestellt hat.
Diese Unterlagen werden benötigt, um Form, Inhalt, getrennte Zustellung und den für eine allfällige Anfechtungsfrist massgeblichen Zugang der Kündigung zu prüfen.
Sie werden benötigt, um die einzelnen Forderungsbestandteile, den offenen reinen Mietzins und die Anrechnung der fristgerecht überwiesenen Zahlung nachvollziehen zu können.
Eine schriftliche Begründung ist erforderlich, um zu klären, ob die Kündigung tatsächlich auf dem Konkurs oder auf einem behaupteten Zahlungsrückstand beruht.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Diese Unterlagen werden benötigt, um die einzelnen Forderungsbestandteile einschließlich der Kühlschrankforderung, den noch offenen reinen Mietzins und die Anrechnung der fristgerecht geleisteten Zahlung nachzuvollziehen.
Die Kündigungsunterlagen werden benötigt, um Form, Kündigungstermin und den geltend gemachten Kündigungsgrund zu prüfen.
Die Zustellnachweise werden benötigt, um den Zugang der Zahlungsaufforderung und einer allfälligen Kündigung sowie den Lauf der jeweiligen Fristen festzustellen.
These documents are needed to verify whether a termination was issued on the required form and when and to whom it was validly served.
These records are needed to establish the amount and date of the tenant’s payment and whether any pure rent arrears remained after it.
Correspondence from the landlord is needed to reconstruct the claimed components, including the refrigerator charge, and any stated allocation of the payment.

These documents are needed to establish the method and date of service of the attached payment demand and therefore when its payment period began.
These are needed to verify whether the alleged rent or ancillary-cost arrears existed and whether payment was made within any deadline.

These are needed to identify the parties’ communications concerning the alleged arrears, payment deadline, and any response or dispute.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to determine the exact demand and statutory warning, the termination’s formal content, and the respective dates and proof of service.
These documents are needed to separate rent from the refrigerator charge, verify the tenant’s timely payment, and reconstruct how the landlord applied it to the outstanding balance.
These documents are needed to identify the amounts and payment deadline demanded, assess the termination notice, and reconstruct when and how the warning and termination were served.
These records are needed to verify the amount and date of the rent payment and determine whether any qualifying rent arrears remained at expiry of the deadline.
The correspondence is needed to distinguish the refrigerator claim from rent and ancillary charges and establish any declared or accepted allocation of the tenant's payment.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed first to verify that the termination used the required official form and to establish the receipt date for the 30-day challenge deadline.
The written defect report, the parties’ communications, and the landlord’s stated reasons are needed to assess the temporal link and test whether the asserted personal need is the actual motive.
A timely conciliation request, including an extension request if desired, is needed to preserve the challenge and tenancy-extension rights before the deadline expires.
These documents are needed to verify the notice's mandatory form, stated termination date, service date, and whether the 30-day challenge deadline is still running.
The correspondence is needed to substantiate the prior written defect report and assess the timing and actual context of the alleged retaliatory termination.
A written statement of reasons is needed to clarify and assess the landlord's asserted own-use requirement and the actual motivation for termination.
A conciliation request is needed to preserve the deadline for challenging the termination while the motive and supporting evidence are clarified.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the mandatory official form and establish the receipt date for the 30-day challenge deadline.
The tenant’s written defect notice and any prior communications are needed to prove the protected assertion of tenancy rights and the temporal connection to the termination.
The landlord’s communications, including a requested written explanation, are needed to assess the asserted personal-use need, the replacement-apartment offer, and the actual motive for termination.
A conciliation request is needed promptly to preserve the statutory deadline for challenging the termination.
These documents are needed to verify the notice’s mandatory form and its receipt date for the 30-day challenge deadline.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents establish whether the termination used the required official form and the receipt date that triggers the 30-day challenge deadline.
The written damp-wall report, subsequent exchanges, and the landlord’s stated reasons are needed to assess the timing and whether the asserted own-use need may be retaliatory.
A conciliation request is needed to preserve a timely challenge to the termination once the receipt date has been confirmed.
These documents are needed to verify the notice's mandatory form and its receipt date and service for the 30-day challenge deadline.
These documents are needed to establish the written defect report, the chronology and communications surrounding it, and the landlord's stated and substantiated own-use reason.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the termination’s mandatory form, its service and receipt date, and therefore the deadline for a challenge.
These documents are needed to establish the reliable chronology of the written damp-wall report and to assess whether the asserted own-use reason was pretextual or retaliatory.
A conciliation request is needed to preserve the 30-day deadline for challenging the termination once the receipt date is established.
These documents establish whether the termination used the required official form and the reliable date and manner of service for the challenge deadline.
These documents are needed to reconstruct the chronology of the damp-wall report and termination and to assess the asserted own-use reason and any retaliatory motive.
A conciliation request is needed to preserve the 30-day deadline if the termination is to be challenged while the motive and chronology are reviewed.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the termination’s mandatory form and reliably establish the date of receipt for the 30-day challenge deadline.

The written damp-wall report, subsequent communications, and the landlord’s stated own-use reasons are needed to assess the chronology and whether the termination was retaliatory or otherwise contrary to good faith.
A conciliation request is needed promptly to preserve the deadline for challenging the termination while the facts and motive are reviewed.
These documents are needed to verify the termination's formal validity and establish the reliable receipt date for the 30-day challenge deadline.

The written damp-defect report, the landlord's own-use communications and replacement-flat offer, and any stated termination reasons are needed to assess the chronology and a potentially retaliatory or bad-faith motive.
A conciliation request is needed to preserve the deadline while the termination motive and chronology are reviewed.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents establish whether the landlord used the required official form and the date and manner of service needed to preserve the 30-day challenge deadline.
The parties' correspondence is needed to verify the dated written defect notice, the two-week sequence, and any evidence bearing on the landlord's actual motive.
A written statement of the landlord's reasons is needed because the asserted personal-use need and its factual basis remain unclarified.
These documents are needed to verify the termination’s formal validity and establish the receipt date for the 30-day challenge deadline.
These documents are needed to prove the prior written defect report, assess the temporal and substantive connection to the termination, and clarify the landlord’s asserted own-use reason.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the termination’s mandatory form and the reliable receipt date for the 30-day challenge deadline.
These documents are needed to establish the chronology of the written damp-wall complaint and assess the landlord’s asserted own-use motive.
A conciliation request is needed to preserve the deadline if the termination is to be challenged.
These documents are needed to verify the termination’s mandatory form and reliably establish service or collection dates for the 30-day challenge deadline.
These documents are needed to establish the chronology of the written damp-wall complaint and assess whether the asserted own-use reason is substantiated or retaliatory.
A conciliation request is needed to preserve the deadline if Drew decides to challenge the termination while the motive and chronology are reviewed.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the prescribed termination form and establish the reliable delivery chronology, including whether separate service was made on the spouse.
These are needed to determine the landlord's stated reason for termination and assess a possible challenge.
The complete termination form is needed to verify the prescribed form, mandatory contents, termination date, and the start of any challenge or extension deadline.
Any available delivery records are needed to establish the reliable receipt chronology and whether the notice was separately served on the spouse.
The landlord’s stated reason and related communications are needed to assess possible abusive termination and the landlord’s interests against an extension.

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify that the termination used the required official form and to establish the reliable delivery chronology, including whether separate service was made to the spouse.
The written arrears warning is needed to verify the amount claimed, the termination threat, and compliance with the required 30-day payment period.
A written statement of the landlord’s reasons is needed to clarify and document the basis asserted for the termination.
These documents are needed to verify the official-form content and reliably establish the notice and delivery chronology, including whether separate service on the spouse occurred.
These documents are needed to verify the asserted rent arrears and whether the statutory payment warning and deadline preceded the termination.
These documents are needed to clarify and substantiate the landlord's actual termination reason.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the prescribed form, the effective termination date and whether the notice was separately served on both spouses.
These documents are needed to establish the landlord’s stated reason and assess whether it supports a challenge to the termination.
The termination form is needed to verify the required official-form content, termination date, and apparent formal validity.
These delivery records are needed together to establish when and to whom the termination was served, including whether separate service on the spouse occurred and the challenge deadline.
The parties' correspondence and any stated reasons are needed to determine whether the landlord provided a reason and to assess the asserted termination ground.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the prescribed termination form, the effective termination date, and whether separate service was made on each spouse.
These documents are needed to establish the landlord's stated reason for termination and assess its support and possible challenge.
The notice itself is needed to verify whether it is a valid official form and whether it was a termination rather than the fixed-term contract expiry.
The available postal documents are needed together to assess whether the notice was separately served on Morgan Shaw and his wife.
The landlord’s stated reason and related correspondence are needed to assess the asserted basis for termination and any possible challenge.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify whether the prescribed termination form was used and to establish the reliable receipt and service chronology, including any separate service issue.
The landlord's stated termination reason and the documented terms of the replacement-flat offer are needed to assess the challenge and extension issues.
The termination form is needed to verify the prescribed form, its mandatory content, and the stated termination date.
The available postal-service records are needed to establish reliable receipt dates and whether the notice was separately served on the spouse.
The landlord's stated reason and related communications are needed to assess the termination ground and its relevance to a possible challenge.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Das Kündigungsformular wird benötigt, um Inhalt, Kündigungstermin und Einhaltung der vorgeschriebenen Form zu prüfen.
Diese Zustellunterlagen werden für beide Ehegatten benötigt, um die separate Zustellung an die Familienwohnung und den massgeblichen Empfangszeitpunkt nachzuweisen.
Die verbindlich geltend gemachte Kündigungsbegründung wird benötigt, um die Kündigung materiell und im Hinblick auf eine Anfechtung oder Erstreckung einzuordnen.
Das Kündigungsformular wird benötigt, um Schriftform, amtliches Formular, Kündigungstermin und die darin enthaltenen Hinweise zu prüfen.
Diese Zustellunterlagen werden benötigt, um Empfang und Fristbeginn sowie die separate Zustellung an beide Ehegatten verlässlich festzustellen.
Die schriftliche Kündigungsbegründung wird benötigt, um den verbindlich geltend gemachten Kündigungsgrund und eine mögliche Anfechtbarkeit zu beurteilen.

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the separate delivery and receipt dates of the termination notices, including whether the 30-day challenge deadline is still running.
The landlord’s stated reason and related correspondence are needed to assess whether the termination may be challengeable.
These documents are needed to establish the actual receipt dates and whether the tenant and spouse were separately served with the termination notices.
These documents are needed to identify the landlord’s asserted termination reason and assess whether the termination may be retaliatory or otherwise contrary to good faith.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to establish the date and separate delivery of each termination notice, including the deadline for any challenge.
The landlord’s stated reason is needed to assess whether the termination may be challenged as contrary to good faith.
These delivery records are needed to verify separate service on the tenant and spouse and to determine the applicable challenge deadline.
The landlord’s stated reason and related communications are needed to assess whether the termination is contestable as contrary to good faith.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Complete official termination forms for both spouses are needed to verify whether the submitted scans are complete and to resolve the conflicting termination dates.
The envelopes and postal delivery records are needed to establish the separate receipt dates and calculate the applicable challenge and extension deadlines.
The landlord’s stated reasons are needed to assess whether the termination may be challengeable on substantive grounds.
A joint conciliation filing and extension request are needed to preserve the tenants’ deadline-sensitive termination and extension rights.
They are needed for each separately addressed notice to verify the actual recipients, service method, and receipt dates that trigger the challenge and extension deadlines.
The landlord's written reasons are needed to assess whether the inconsistent family-home terminations are contestable and to evaluate the landlord's interests against any extension request.
A timely joint extension request and conciliation request are needed to preserve the tenants' statutory remedies while the termination's validity and effective date remain unresolved.

requests.why: Vollständige amtliche Kündigungsformulare und die Zustellnachweise für beide Ehegatten sind erforderlich, um das tatsächliche Empfangsdatum, die unterschiedliche Kündigungstermine und die formelle Gültigkeit zu klären.
Die gesamte Korrespondenz der Vermieterschaft zur Kündigung kann erläutern, welches Vertragsende tatsächlich beabsichtigt war und ob eine Korrektur oder Begründung erfolgt ist.
Ein gemeinsam für beide Ehegatten vorbereitetes Schlichtungs- und Erstreckungsbegehren wird benötigt, um die 30-tägige Frist ab jeweiligem Empfang zu wahren und die Erstreckung geltend zu machen.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Complete originals or full copies of both official termination forms and the related delivery evidence are needed to verify the inconsistent termination dates, form completeness, and each spouse’s receipt date.
The landlord’s written reasons are needed to assess whether the termination can be challenged on substantive good-faith grounds.
A joint extension request and the corresponding conciliation filing are needed to seek an extension and preserve the applicable deadline.
Obtain complete copies of both termination forms, including the missing second page if it exists, to verify the stated termination date and statutory form content.
Obtain all available service records for each spouse to establish the separate delivery or collection dates and calculate the challenge and extension deadlines.
Request the landlord's reasons for termination to assess whether the termination is contestable and whether an extension is excluded.
A signed joint challenge and extension filing is needed to preserve the applicable deadlines while the inconsistent notices are clarified.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: A complete copy of the spouse’s official form and the delivery records for both notices are needed to verify the differing termination dates, separate service, and the running of the challenge deadline.
The landlord’s reasons are needed to assess whether the termination may be challenged on substantive good-faith grounds.
The separate receipt dates and service of each notice must be verified to calculate the challenge deadline and assess compliance with separate-service requirements.
The landlord’s reasons are needed to assess whether the termination may be challenged as contrary to good faith.
A conciliation request is needed to preserve the 30-day deadline for challenging the termination.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These are needed to establish the separate effective-delivery dates for each spouse and calculate the 30-day challenge and extension deadlines.
The landlord’s reasons are needed to assess the contradictory termination notices and any challenge for breach of good faith.
These are needed together to preserve the challenge deadline and assert the spouses’ joint request for an extension of the family-home lease.
These service documents are needed to establish the delivery dates and separate service of each termination notice to the spouses.
The landlord’s reasons are needed to assess whether the termination is contestable and to clarify the basis for the conflicting notices.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Complete copies of both notices, including all pages, and the envelope are needed to verify the mandatory form content and determine the receipt date and applicable 30-day challenge deadline.
Written correspondence from the landlord or property manager is needed to establish whether either termination was validly withdrawn, corrected, or intended to replace the other.
These documents are needed to establish the service method and receipt date for each conflicting termination notice and preserve the applicable challenge deadline.
Written confirmation of which notice, if either, was intended to apply and the landlord's stated reasons is needed to assess the effective termination and any challenge grounds.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Complete copies of both notices and the delivery and correction communications are needed to determine their formal validity, receipt dates, and whether either notice unambiguously replaced the other.
The statutory arrears-termination basis requires verification of the written 30-day payment demand, termination threat, and the asserted unpaid rent.
These documents are needed to establish how and when each conflicting termination notice was served so that the applicable challenge deadline can be determined.
The written payment-demand warning is needed to verify the asserted 30-day deadline and termination threat underlying the alleged arrears termination.
Written correspondence from the property management is needed to establish whether either notice was validly corrected, withdrawn, or identified as controlling.

requests.why: These documents are needed to establish the dispatch and receipt sequence of both notices and to verify whether the landlord clearly replaced or withdrew one of them.
Complete copies of both official termination forms and the service evidence are needed to verify their full contents, sequence, and the earliest receipt date for any challenge deadline.
Written confirmation of whether either notice was corrected or replaced, the comparable replacement offer, and the landlord's reasons is needed to identify the operative termination and assess it.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Complete copies of both official termination forms and the available delivery evidence are needed to establish their full contents, the dates of notification, and the earliest deadline.
Written correspondence from the management is needed to verify whether either termination was expressly corrected, replaced, or withdrawn.
Complete copies of both official termination forms and the envelope are needed to verify their full contents, service details, and the earliest potentially applicable challenge deadline.
Any written communication from the property manager is needed to establish whether one notice expressly corrected, replaced, or withdrew the other.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Complete copies of both official termination forms and delivery evidence are needed to assess their formal validity, identify the controlling termination date, and calculate the 30-day challenge deadline.
Any written communication from the landlord or property manager is needed to establish whether one of the two termination notices was expressly withdrawn or corrected.
Complete copies of both termination forms are needed to assess their required content and determine which notice, if any, controls.
Delivery documents are needed to establish the service date and protect the applicable challenge deadline.
Written confirmation of the alleged correction and the landlord’s reasons is needed to clarify the controlling end date and assess the termination.

requests.why: Complete copies of both official termination forms and the envelope are needed to verify the mandatory form content, all pages, dispatch/receipt circumstances, and the applicable challenge deadline.
Written correspondence from the property manager is needed to establish whether either termination was validly corrected, withdrawn, or intended to replace the other.
Complete copies of every page of both official termination forms are needed to assess their required content and determine whether either notice clearly replaces the other.
The available delivery evidence is needed to establish the receipt date and preserve the earliest applicable deadline for challenging the notices.
Written communication from the property manager is needed to clarify whether one termination was intended as a correction and whether the other was revoked.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Complete copies of both official termination forms and the envelope are needed to verify all mandatory form contents, the competing termination dates, and service details.

Written confirmation of the alleged correction, the operative termination, the replacement-apartment offer, and the termination reasons is needed to assess which notice governs and whether it may be challenged.
These are needed to establish the service date and method for each termination and preserve the earliest challenge deadline.
Written correspondence from the management is needed to determine whether either notice was expressly corrected, replaced, or withdrawn.
The landlord’s written reasons are needed to assess whether either termination may be challenged on substantive grounds.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Complete copies of both termination forms are needed to verify the mandatory information and whether either notice expressly supersedes the other.
The envelope and any registered-mail receipt are needed to establish the dispatch and receipt dates for the applicable challenge deadline.
Written correspondence from the property manager is needed to prove or disprove that one of the contradictory notices was validly corrected, withdrawn, or replaced.

Complete copies of both termination forms, written evidence of the alleged correction, and proof of dispatch or delivery are needed to determine the operative notice, verify mandatory form content and service, and preserve the challenge deadline.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Vollständige amtliche Kündigungsformulare sowie Zustellnachweise werden benötigt, um die Formgültigkeit beider Kündigungen, ihren vollständigen Inhalt und den Beginn der Anfechtungsfrist zu prüfen.
Eine schriftliche Mitteilung der Verwaltung ist erforderlich, um zu klären, ob und wie eine Kündigung wirksam als Korrektur oder Ersatz der anderen bezeichnet wurde.
Obtain complete copies of both termination forms, including every page and any attachments, to assess their required content and the conflicting termination dates.
Obtain the available delivery evidence to establish how and when each termination was served and thus preserve the applicable challenge deadline.
Obtain written confirmation of which notice, if any, was intended to replace the other and the landlord's stated reason for termination.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify that a valid termination was issued and determine the date of receipt for any challenge or extension deadline.
The landlord’s project information and any stated termination reasons are needed to assess whether the renovation, schedule, and need to vacate are sufficiently concrete.
Correspondence documenting the nine housing enquiries and six refusals is needed to substantiate the tenant’s efforts to find replacement accommodation for an extension request.
Diese Unterlagen werden benötigt, um Form, Inhalt, separate Zustellung und den Empfangstag der Kündigung sowie allfällige Anfechtungsfristen zu prüfen.
Die Projektbroschüre und eine konkrete Kündigungsbegründung werden benötigt, um den Sanierungsgrund, den verbindlichen Bauablauf und die tatsächliche Notwendigkeit einer Räumung zu beurteilen.
Korrespondenz zu den neun Wohnungsanfragen und sechs Absagen wird benötigt, um die Wohnungssuchbemühungen und die Härte für einen Erstreckungsantrag zu belegen.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: The actual official termination form and the available delivery evidence are needed to assess formal validity and determine any deadline for contesting the termination or requesting an extension.
The manager’s communications and a written statement of reasons are needed to verify the renovation project, timetable, and whether vacant possession is genuinely required.
These documents are needed to determine whether a formal termination was issued, whether the prescribed form was used, and when and to whom it was served.
The project brochure, any further landlord communications, and the landlord’s stated reasons are needed to assess the asserted renovation, works schedule, and alleged need for vacant possession.
Copies of the housing enquiries and rejections are needed to substantiate the tenant’s documented search efforts and accessibility-related hardship for an extension request.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These are needed to determine whether a valid landlord termination was served and the date from which any 30-day challenge deadline runs.
A written termination rationale and the complete renovation communications are needed to assess the asserted renovation and vacant-possession need.
These documents are needed to verify whether a formal termination was served and to establish the receipt date for any challenge deadline.

The landlord’s documented termination reasons, renovation schedule, vacant-possession need, project brochure, and terms of the replacement-flat offer are needed to assess the asserted renovation basis and whether the offered flat is genuinely equivalent.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to establish whether a valid termination was issued and to assess the asserted renovation works, timetable, and claimed need for vacant possession.
Correspondence concerning the nine housing enquiries and six rejections is needed to substantiate the tenant’s accessibility-related housing-search hardship for a possible extension request.
These documents are needed to verify whether a valid official termination was issued and when it was effectively served for the applicable challenge or extension deadline.
The landlord's project communications and any stated reasons are needed to assess the asserted renovation and vacant-possession need and the termination's good-faith basis.
The tenant's housing enquiries and rejection responses are needed to document the accessibility-related housing-search hardship supporting an extension.
An extension request is needed to seek continued tenancy based on the tenant's long occupancy, accessibility needs, and unsuccessful housing search.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to establish whether a valid termination was issued and the date from which the 30-day challenge and extension deadline runs.
The landlord’s project communications and any stated reasons are needed to assess whether the renovation and alleged need for vacant possession support the termination.
Correspondence concerning the nine housing enquiries and rejections is needed to substantiate the tenant’s housing-search hardship for an extension request.
These documents are needed to establish whether a legally effective termination was issued and when and how it was served.
The landlord’s project communications, termination reasons, and any works schedule are needed to assess the asserted renovation and vacant-possession rationale.
Correspondence concerning the nine housing enquiries and six rejections is needed to document the tenant’s housing-search hardship for a potential extension request.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Diese Unterlagen sind erforderlich, um festzustellen, ob eine formgültige Kündigung zugestellt wurde und ob eine allfällige 30-tägige Anfechtungs- oder Erstreckungsfrist läuft.
Die Kommunikation des Vermieters und eine Begründung werden benötigt, um Renovierungsvorhaben, Zeitplan, Leerstandsbedarf sowie die Bedingungen und Gleichwertigkeit der Ersatzwohnung zu prüfen.
Die dokumentierten Wohnungssuchen und Absagen sind für die Beurteilung einer Härte und eines möglichen Erstreckungsbegehrens erforderlich.
These documents are needed to determine whether a valid termination was issued and when it was served for any challenge or extension deadline.
The landlord’s project communications and termination reasons are needed to assess the asserted renovation, works schedule, vacant-possession need, and terms of the proposed replacement flat.
Records of the nine housing enquiries and rejections are needed to substantiate the tenant’s housing-search hardship and efforts for an extension request.

The landlord's communications and stated reasons are needed to verify the renovation timetable and whether vacant possession is genuinely required.
Correspondence concerning the housing enquiries and rejections is needed to substantiate the tenant's documented search efforts for an extension request.
These documents are needed to establish whether a valid termination was issued and to assess the asserted renovation, works schedule, and claimed need for vacant possession.
The tenant's correspondence may document requests for clarification, the landlord's responses, and the reported unsuccessful housing enquiries relevant to an extension request.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to verify the termination’s mandatory form, stated ground, and effective receipt date for any challenge.
These documents are needed to establish whether a legally compliant payment warning was served and whether the alleged arrears remained unpaid when its deadline expired.

The manager’s correspondence, project brochure, and any requested termination reasons are needed to assess whether renovation and vacant-possession needs rather than arrears were the actual basis for termination.
These documents are needed to establish whether a valid termination notice was issued and when and to whom it was served.
These documents are needed to verify that the statutory payment warning, 30-day period, termination threat, and service requirements were met before a default-based termination.
These documents are needed to determine the amount and due status of any rent arrears and whether payment was made within the warning period.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Die Kündigung und der nachweisbare Empfang sind nötig, um Formgültigkeit, Kündigungstermin und die 30-tägige Frist für Anfechtung oder Erstreckung zu prüfen.

Die gesamte Kommunikation der Verwaltung einschliesslich Projektbroschüre sowie eine konkrete Kündigungsbegründung werden benötigt, um Sanierungsgrund, verbindlichen Bauablauf und den tatsächlichen Leerbedarfszeitpunkt zu beurteilen.
Die Wohnungsanfragen und Absagen werden benötigt, um die Wohnungssuche und die geltend gemachte Härte für ein Erstreckungsbegehren zu belegen.
These documents are needed to verify the termination’s formal validity and establish the date of receipt for any challenge or extension deadline.
These documents are needed to assess the asserted renovation reason and whether a binding construction schedule actually requires the apartment to be vacated.
Correspondence concerning the nine housing enquiries and six refusals is needed to substantiate the tenant’s housing-search hardship for an extension request.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to determine whether a valid official-form termination was separately sent and when and to which address it was served.
This document is needed to verify whether the apparent case manager or management company had authority to issue the termination for the landlord.
A precautionary conciliation request is needed to preserve the 30-day challenge and extension deadline if a valid paper termination is found to have been received.
Obtain the alleged paper termination notice to verify whether the landlord used the required cantonal form and complied with the mandatory content and written-form requirements.
Obtain the available postal-service records to establish whether, when, and to which address any paper termination was separately served or made available for collection.
Obtain the management authority document to verify whether the case manager or property manager was authorised to issue termination notice for the landlord.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These are needed to determine whether a valid official-form termination was issued and when and by which postal channel it was served.
This is needed to verify whether the case manager or management company was authorised to issue the landlord's termination.
These are needed together to verify the written 30-day arrears warning, the amount due, and whether payment was made within the deadline.
A conciliation request is needed as a precaution to preserve the 30-day challenge deadline while receipt of any valid paper termination remains uncertain.
These documents are needed to determine whether a paper termination on the required official form was separately and validly served, including the operative receipt date for any challenge deadline.
These documents are needed to verify the written arrears warning, the full payment period and termination threat, and its service before the arrears-based termination.
This is needed to clarify whether the case manager who sent the termination was authorised to act for the landlord.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to establish whether a prescribed official termination form was separately sent and when any postal delivery or collection occurred.
These documents are needed to clarify whether Limmat Verwaltungs GmbH was authorised to issue a legally binding termination on the landlord’s behalf.
A precautionary conciliation request is needed to preserve the 30-day challenge and extension deadlines if a valid termination is found to have been received.

A copy of any canton-approved postal termination form and the property-management authority is needed to determine whether a valid termination was issued by an authorized party rather than only the emailed PDF.
These postal-service records are needed to establish whether, to whom, and when any separate written termination was sent or made available for collection.

requests.why: Diese Unterlagen klären, ob neben der E-Mail eine formgültige Kündigung zugestellt wurde und wann sowie an welche Adresse der Zugang erfolgte.
Diese Unterlagen sind erforderlich, um Inhalt, Zustellung und Ablauf der 30-tägigen Zahlungsfrist sowie den behaupteten Zahlungsrückstand zu prüfen.
Der Verwaltungsvertrag kann belegen, ob die Limmat Verwaltungs GmbH zur rechtsverbindlichen Kündigung im Namen des Vermieters bevollmächtigt war.
Diese Unterlagen werden benötigt, um festzustellen, ob neben der E-Mail eine formgültige Kündigung zugestellt wurde und wann sowie an wen die Zustellung erfolgte.
Das Mahnschreiben wird benötigt, um die Einhaltung der Voraussetzungen der Kündigung wegen Zahlungsrückstands zu prüfen.
Der Verwaltungsvertrag wird benötigt, um zu klären, ob die Verwaltung zur rechtsverbindlichen Abgabe der Kündigung befugt war.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: Diese Unterlagen klären, ob eine formgültige Kündigung vorliegt, wer sie rechtsverbindlich im Namen des Vermieters ausgestellt hat und welche Begründung gegeben wurde.
Diese Zustellnachweise sind erforderlich, um einen allfälligen schriftlichen Versand, die Zustelladresse und den fristauslösenden Empfang festzustellen.
Ein Schlichtungsgesuch ist vorsorglich erforderlich, um eine allfällige 30-tägige Frist zur Anfechtung der Kündigung zu wahren.
These documents are needed to determine whether a written canton-approved termination form was issued and when, to whom, and by which delivery channels it was served.
This is needed to verify whether the case handler or property manager who sent the communication was authorised to issue a legally binding termination on the landlord's behalf.
A conciliation request is needed to preserve the 30-day deadline for challenging a termination while the validity and service evidence are being clarified.

requests.why: These documents are needed to establish whether the landlord or an authorised manager issued a valid official-form termination and how, when, and to which address it was served.
A conciliation request should be prepared and filed without delay to preserve any 30-day challenge period for a purported early termination, notwithstanding the contractually fixed end date.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: The original email/PDF and any official-form or postal-delivery records are needed to verify the termination's form, sender, address, and receipt date.
This is needed to establish whether the property manager or its employee was authorised to issue the termination on the landlord's behalf.
These are needed to establish whether a valid landlord-issued written termination on the required official form exists and what, if anything, was communicated by email.
These are needed to clarify whether any postal termination was sent, to which address, and when it was delivered or made available for collection.
This is needed to verify whether the case handler or property manager who purported to issue the termination had authority to act for the landlord.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to establish whether a valid official termination form was sent, to which address, by which delivery route, and when it was received or made available.
These documents are needed to identify the legally authorised issuer of the purported termination and to determine the landlord's stated termination grounds.
A conciliation request is needed to preserve the 30-day deadline for challenging the termination if the applicable receipt date is established or precautionary filing is required.

These documents are needed to establish whether a valid official-form notice was separately sent, by whom, through which delivery channel, and on what date it was received or made available for collection.
This is needed to verify whether the property manager or other stated sender was authorised to issue the termination on the landlord’s behalf.
The landlord’s stated reason is needed to assess whether the termination may be challengeable on substantive good-faith grounds.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: These documents are needed to determine whether a valid official termination form exists, who legally issued it, and whether the named property manager was authorised to act for the landlord.
Any available postal delivery documents are needed to clarify whether, when, and to which address a written termination was separately sent or made available for collection.
A conciliation request is needed promptly to preserve the 30-day deadline for challenging any termination received on or around 1 May 2026.
Diese Unterlagen werden benötigt, um den genauen Inhalt der E-Mail/PDF-Mitteilung, eine allfällige kantonal genehmigte Kündigung auf Formular sowie Absender und allfällige Reaktionen festzustellen.
Diese Zustellbelege sind erforderlich, um zu klären, ob und wann eine separate schriftliche Kündigung an eine Adresse zugestellt oder zur Abholung gemeldet wurde.
Der Verwaltungsvertrag kann belegen, ob die Sachbearbeiterin oder Verwaltung zur rechtsverbindlichen Kündigung im Namen der Vermieterschaft bevollmächtigt war.
Ein vorsorglich eingereichtes Schlichtungsgesuch wird benötigt, um die 30-tägige Frist zur Anfechtung der Kündigung zu wahren.

scope: a tenant who has received a termination of a residential or commercial lease and is considering challenging it as void, abusive or improperly served, or requesting an extension

requests.why: The complete emailed PDF and related landlord communications are needed to verify the notice’s content, form, named issuer, and whether a canton-approved termination form was used.
These delivery records are needed to establish whether any separate postal termination was sent, to which address, and when it was received or made available for collection.
The management agreement is needed to clarify whether the caseworker or property manager was authorized to issue a termination on the landlord’s behalf.
A filed or prepared conciliation request is needed to evidence or secure a timely challenge to any termination that may be legally effective.
